query:
SELECT 
  fr.id,
  fr.vessel_name,
  fr.client_name,
  fr.recorded_by,
  u.name as recorded_by_name,
  fr.recorded_at
FROM fuel_records fr
LEFT JOIN users u ON fr.recorded_by = u.id
WHERE MONTH(fr.created_at) = 12 AND YEAR(fr.created_at) = 2025
ORDER BY fr.created_at DESC
LIMIT 5;
